stories.title: Topcoat 0.9 adds server-push UI updates to a Rust web framework
stories.originalTitle: Topcoat is pushing the boundary of server applications with Rust
stories.whatChanged: Topcoat 0.9 adds WebSocket-based subscriptions for server-pushed UI changes. The framework also supports rerunning server-rendered shards when browser-side signals change, while Toasty adds database update macros, document fields, and polymorphic relations.
stories.whyItMatters: These features let developers build reactive interfaces that combine browser-side interaction with server-rendered updates and database access in Rust.

stories.title: Whiteboard pairs coding agents with a design canvas and semantic diffs
stories.originalTitle: Show HN: Whiteboard (YC W26) – An open-source IDE for thoughtful software design
stories.whatChanged: Whiteboard is an open-source desktop app that connects coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to a shared canvas. It links visualizations to underlying code and includes a Rust-based, AST-aware diff viewer with customizable defaults and a WASM plugin system.
stories.whyItMatters: The app brings agent explanations, diagrams, and code review into one workspace. It runs against local checkouts, but currently does not support editing files in the app.
stories.confidenceReason: The supplied project description directly states the app's features, license, and current editing limitation.
